subject.title: transcripts: show prints stored terminal escapes from imported text

question: Should this public transcript terminal-control report proceed as a normal CLI hardening fix, and should sanitization happen at persistence, display, or both?
rationale: The code defect is narrow, but the issue is security-labeled and the boundary choice changes whether stored `summary.md` remains a raw artifact or becomes terminal-safe at rest.

options.title: Public hardening at summary/display boundary
options.body: Treat the already-public, limited-blast-radius issue as a normal hardening bug and require focused tests for the chosen boundary before close.

options.title: Security triage before repair
options.body: Pause repair until security reviewers decide whether advisory-style handling is needed despite the public report.

options.title: Display-only mitigation
options.body: Preserve raw stored markdown and sanitize only terminal stdout, accepting that other readers of `summary.md` must handle terminal safety themselves.

recommendation.title: Public hardening at summary/display boundary
recommendation.body: Treat the already-public, limited-blast-radius issue as a normal hardening bug and require focused tests for the chosen boundary before close.
